configuration.datasets: All eight subsets of the synthetic three-user roster. Outputs conditioned to count=1 or histogram=(1,0,0,0).
configuration.operations: One or two admitted/withheld operations, one or two fixed recipient contexts.
configuration.recipient_setup: All public receiver contexts bootstrapped empty before the episode; initial observed clock is zero.
configuration.fault_schedule: One explicit reachable receiver or sender-confirmation cut per episode. Schedule chosen independently of private input. Driver quiesces all modeled events until the affected replica is restored.
configuration.transport: In-process calls except actual child-process exit. Separate local SQLite authority files; no network service or host isolation.

observation_inputs: Public configuration and signed caller inputs
Approved operation-bound mechanism outputs and explicit signing resource
Public clock, operation ID, delivery/terminal kind, independent attempt challenge
Explicit cut location, affected side and restore command
forbidden_generator_inputs: Witness image, version, digest or actual commit outcome
Actual receiver facts or service response bytes
Private random tapes, data records or diagnostic state projections

events.DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: Generated outgoing signed attempt and absence of reply; no commit bit or hidden receipt.
events.CONFIRM_UNAVAILABLE: Previously observed signed request/receipt supplied to confirmation and absence of completion.
events.DELIVERY_RECOVER: Trusted driver reports fresh replica restoration for the declared side and operation; no storage contents exposed.

state_relation.R1-R4: Authorization/request/cache, accounts, scheduling and publication; checked against authoritative state at cuts and restored local state afterwards.
state_relation.R5-R8: Prepared evidence, receiver first facts, sender confirmation/route root and maximal final prefix. Initial empty receivers are an explicit public setup parameter.
state_relation.R11: Witness and local atomicity, stale-guard rejection, other authority unchanged, byte-identical fresh restoration without advancing witness.
state_relation.diagnostic_replica: One ephemeral fresh restore per cut to inspect authoritative projections. Separately counted from the operational fresh restore. Never input to simulator.

projection: Generated logical history distinguishes precommit no-receive from durable receive with lost ACK, and nondurable versus durable confirmation. It is internal relation evidence, not additional public traffic.
excluded: Interruption during diagnostic or operational recovery
Multiple combined public/private/delivery faults per episode
TLS failure mapping and full physical timing/length observations
Power loss, cross-host persistence and production nonrollback
Output-distribution or general inductive/cryptographic refinement proof
